title: Finish a first change before offering optional growth
preconditions: A comparison has changed source whose implementation Items account for every changed line.

steps.action: Inspect the authoring loop while only implementation coverage is complete.
steps.expected_result: The required work ends with explaining the current change and does not require personas, stories, design, or test cases.

steps.action: Inspect the ordered next actions and their command or question shapes.
steps.expected_result: Required actions are stable and each action contains one command or one focused question.

steps.action: Re-evaluate after the current change is fully explained.
steps.expected_result: The first-run loop stops and optional product-knowledge growth is offered separately afterward.

expected_result: Pass when the first change ends at current source explanation and optional growth follows as focused deterministic suggestions; fail if optional documentation blocks the loop or actions are unstable.
